text_block_list.text:
It's the Takarazuka Kinen. Мэйсё Дото,

stationed right behind Т.М. Опера О,
assumes her
role as Opera O's
second-in-command.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Half a year earlier, when Адмайр Вега
was forced
to drop out, Т.М. Опера О
had spoken of having
no choice but to
wait.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In truth, what she was waiting for was
Meisho
Doto's awakening. The time has
come for Doto to
display her
race-readiness through her running.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
